summary: The blind compare flagged 015, 024 and 054 as ambiguous: standalone 以后 is acceptable for past narration (so 后来 vs 以后 alone was not forced) and 我去帮了一下午 is acceptable colloquially; these were rewritten so one option is forced. Systematic defect fixed: several 'why' texts claimed standalone 以后 can only mean 'from now on', which is false; 023's 参观 distractor was grammatical in 去云南参观 and was replaced. Judgement calls left: 033 (觉得 with 没想到, kept as 以为) and 044 (生病的经验 rejected).

near-synonyms-03-015.note: 以后 alone is fine for past narration; rewritten as clause + 以后 vs 后来.

near-synonyms-03-024.note: 我去帮了一下午 is acceptable; rewritten as noun 帮助 vs verb 帮 after 很多.

near-synonyms-03-054.note: 以后 alone acceptable for past; rewritten as future 以后 vs 后来, why corrected.

near-synonyms-03-011.note: why falsely said 以后 alone only means 'from now on'.

near-synonyms-03-088.note: why falsely said 以后 alone only means 'from now on'.

near-synonyms-03-023.note: 去云南参观 is grammatical; distractor changed to 看望 (needs a person object).

near-synonyms-03-018.note: en 'feel a bad headache' made natural.
